---
title: TypedEnv
---

### Function
```ts
type GenericObjectSchema = ObjectSchema<ObjectEntries, undefined>
```

### Options
```ts
class TypedEnv<TSchema extends GenericObjectSchema>{}
```

### Examples
```ts
import { TypedEnv } from "@mpaynesecurity/rsbuild-plugin-hydra/env"

export const env = new TypedEnv(object({
	PORT: pipe(string(), transform((val) => parseInt(val, 10)), number()),
}))
```
